name: Epic's All in One
teaser: An all in one expansion of the weapons and weapon parts of the game complete with the Badger trader.
description:
Introduction

Hey guys,

This mod aims to add a large variety of configurability to tarkov weapons in the form of way more gun parts, guns, and options for modding your weapons with the addition of a themed trader that has quests. Not many for now, but I do plan to make more.

The trader Badger unlocks at level 12 following the quest “Stranded” on Mechanic

This mod will be getting separated into packs that will not use the trader so that people can slim down the amount of items they are importing into the game. This will have more time allocated to it now that I am no longer adding items actively, so I will only have to do bug-fixes and upkeep will not take 33 hours a week with a full time job like it has up to this point to get here.

Starting with Version 2.0.0 I no longer am bundling a realism patch. Please use one of the patches available elsewhere on the hub.

KNOWN ISSUES:

  • Need presets for some of the new weapons added by the mod
  • Need to fix the starting loadout M4 preset
  • Texture remastering on some items
  • Bipods, but they’re not broken anymore

Glowing items left to retexture:

  • SAG MK3 handguards
  • Let me know if there are more, please

ISSUES ALREADY FIXED - WAITING ON UPDATE:

  • Elcan 1.5-6x not working
  • Raid XE not working
  • Base game ACOGs not working

How To Install and Compatibility

How to install:

  1. Download the latest release by clicking the button above.
  2. Open the downloaded zip file with your choice of archive manager (DO NOT USE THE BUILT IN WINDOWS ONE)
  3. Put the contents of the zip file into your SPT folder
  4. Enjoy!

Compatibility:

  • Most other content mods work with this, report any that don’t.

Incompatibility:

  • If you are not using a patch for this mod with realism you will have many issues. Either make your own patch or wait for someone to make one. I do not have one.

The standard way to troubleshoot this mod is as follows:

  1. If you have issues when you install this mod, try making a new profile (preferably a dev bear profile) and make sure your game works. I do this by standard with my mod prior to release anyways, so it should always work.
  2. Add your previously used mods and boot the game and run a raid after each installed mod. This is to see if anything is conflicting with my mod. Tell me what is conflicting and what your error message is so that I can verify whether it can be fixed or if it just needs to be added to incompatibilities.
  3. If you are using something that is already listed as an incompatibility I am not going to help you.

versions.description:
Please delete the previous version of the mod before updating! There have been changes in the file paths so files will be left over if you just replace the old mod with the new one!

Remastered tons of items with new textures and shaders! Deduplicated a ton of assets, so despite adding a bunch of stuff the mod size actually went DOWN! Rebalanced the magnification and sensitivity of all scopes in the mod to a standard base. They are all standardized across the board now, if it’s different than BSG’s magnification then I don’t care.

Added:

  • Leupold CQBSS 1-8x Scope
  • Leupold MK5HD 5-25x (Mil FDE) Scope
  • Leupold MK5HD 3.6-18x Scope (Black and FDE)
  • Trijicon Accupower 1-8x Scope
  • Vortex Eleanor 1-10x Scope (Both FDE and Black)
  • Nightforce ATACR F1 1-8x Scope
  • Nightforce ATACR 4-16x Scope
  • Nightforce ATACR 4-20x Scope
  • Kahles K624i 6-24x Scope
  • FDE X-15 5.56 Mag
  • New Daniel Defense RIS II rails
  • KAC 7 Rib rail panel
  • Daniel Defense picatinny rail cover
  • Wilson Combat Starburst pistol grip
  • BCM Gunfighter Mod3 pistol grip

Fixed:

  • Lasers, in general
  • Scope masking, in general
  • Scar rear sight not appearing on scar uppers
  • AK-15 stock compat with new AKs
  • Magnfiiers eye relief

The Wilcox RAID-XE does not work in this version as I am awaiting a new model for it, not happy with the current one.

Enjoy!

  • A few quests using the incorrect data type for some conditions

Added:

  • Gun quest rewards for some badger quests

versions.description: added helper method for dogtag quests

Version so good it jumped a number!

  • new hideout crafting expansion by pein, now supports multi-endproducts and endproducts with nested children
  • reworked custom parent mapping into a server service + client attribute (also by pein)
  • separated logic in the slothelper methods, added a new one

• added new itemservice helper for adding items to blacklist
  • fixed nuget package forcibly including the en.json locale for the salvage zones in your project /bonk
  • fixed slothelper method and added support for creating new slot info
• fixed hideout crafts service not supporting anything but arrays /bonk

• Added new helper to slothelper to add ids by name
  • Added fix custom item sort order patch (thanks Pein! ❤ )
  • Added new “Salvage” zones to possible quest types
  • Added locales for the salvage zone interactions
  • Fixed hideout crafts not supporting .jsonc /bonk

• Implemented random loot container support for customitemserviceextended
  • Added save method to confighelper

HOTFIX NUMBER 2 FOR THE DAY REEEEEEE

  • fixed caliberhelper from being completely broken. PLEASE DOWNLOAD THIS VERSION IF YOU UPDATED TODAY.
• fixed questhelper adding to empty weapon conditions (specifically a punisher part 4 issue)

• added weapon mod quest helper method
  • added CustomDialogueService for custom NPC Dialogues
  • changed CaliberHelper to process deferred like modslots (should allow for better compatibility for ammo)
  • fixed custom modslot images becoming blurry on low texture settings (Thanks Pein!)

Configured the stencil buffer on the shaders to allow you to select the stencil type as normal and have it function properly.

Added metallic slider to allow post adjustments rather than requiring you to open your texturing software again.

As always, enjoy!
